profile.name: AF Gruppen ASA
profile.summary: AF Gruppen ASA, a contracting and industrial company, provides civil engineering, construction, energy and environment, and property and offshore services in Norway and Sweden. The company provides civil engineering services, including construction of various projects, such as roads, railways, airports, foundation work, building, fitting and securing tunnels, bridges, port facilities, tunnels, renovation and construction of concrete structures, power and energy plants, and onshore facilities for oil and gas; and concrete technology, groundwork and earthmoving, geomatics and surveying, and project support services. It also operates as a turnkey contractor for the development and planning to buildings comprising residential, commercial, public buildings, and rehabilitation and rebuilding, as well as offers extension work services. In addition, the company provides energy solutions, which includes energy performing contracting, technical turnkey contract, local power supply, and technical services and maintenance; and energy solutions for existing and new buildings. Further, the company manages construction and decommissioning projects, including removal and recycling of offshore installations; offers turnkey services in the areas of cooling and ventilation for onshore and offshore installations, rigs, and ships, as well as offshore wind services; and operates as a contractor for demolition and environmental clean-up services for buildings and structures, such as blasting, dredging, handling of contaminated bulk material, and removal of shipwrecks. Additionally, it provides office spaces on rental basis, and sale of homes. AF Gruppen ASA was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.
profile.summary_fr: AF Gruppen ASA, société contractuelle et industrielle, fournit des services de génie civil, de construction, d'énergie et d'environnement, ainsi que des services immobiliers et offshore en Norvège et en Suède. La société fournit des services de génie civil, y compris la construction de divers projets, tels que les routes, les chemins de fer, les aéroports, les travaux de fondation, la construction, l'aménagement et la sécurisation de tunnels, de ponts, d'installations portuaires, de tunnels, la rénovation et la construction de structures en béton, de centrales électriques et énergétiques et d'installations terrestres pour le pétrole et le gaz; et la technologie du béton, les travaux au sol et le terrassement. Il opère également en tant qu'entrepreneur clé en main pour le développement et la planification de bâtiments comprenant des bâtiments résidentiels, commerciaux, publics, ainsi que la réhabilitation et la reconstruction, ainsi que des services de travaux de vulgarisation.
